about.en: EUR CoinVertible (EURCV) is a euro stablecoin issued by Societe Generale-FORGE, the digital-assets subsidiary of the Societe Generale banking group. It is fully collateralised, redeemable 1:1 for euros and issued under MiCA as an e-money token, on Ethereum at 0x5F7827FDeb7c20b443265Fc2F40845B715385Ff2 and on Solana, Stellar, the XRP Ledger and Canton.
